subtitle: Draw the fuse, time the sky
description:
Wickwalk is a timing puzzle game drawn in coloured chalk. A little spark is burning along a fuse, and the fuse only goes where you draw it. Rockets keep popping up around the fairground, each with a ring that fills like a clock. Draw the fuse so the spark reaches each rocket just as its ring closes, and it bursts into chalk fireworks.

The spark burns at a steady pace, so the length of your fuse is time. Wiggle it to make the spark wait. Go straight to hurry. A small tick on every ring shows when the spark will arrive, so you can bend the fuse until it lines up with the gold mark at the top.

The spark lights anything it touches, so pass a rocket too early and it fizzles. Leave one too long and it tips over. Let the spark catch up with the end of your fuse and it smoulders out. Touch any unlit part of the fuse to redraw it from there. As the show goes on, the spark speeds up, rockets come in pairs and big ones, and a passing drizzle slows the fuse where it falls.

One finger, one fixed screen, short shows and a best score to beat. Chain perfect launches for a bigger multiplier and earn back lost chalk. Plays fully offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: A spark races along the fuse you draw. Wiggle it to wait, straighten it to hurry, and reach every rocket just as it is ready to bloom into chalk fireworks.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Drag from the end of the fuse to draw where the spark goes next, so it reaches each rocket as the ring around it closes. The show ends after three misses (a rocket that is never lit, or the spark reaching the end of the fuse and smouldering out).
